description: Enforced field set and enums for the declarative egress/PII sanitization gate record. Single source read by scripts/validate_egress_sanitization.py; the prose egress-sanitization-record.schema.md documents intent and rules and does not restate these lists. Procedural rules (PASSED forbids any BLOCKED unit; BLOCKED requires a BLOCKED unit and keeps the output incomplete; SANITIZED/BLOCKED/EXCLUDED units require a rule_locator; ALLOWED units carry no finding; NOT_ATTEMPTED/UNVERIFIABLE require a limitation and empty units; finding_kind is a category label, never the sensitive value) stay in the validator. assurance_level is DECLARED or UNVERIFIABLE, never VERIFIED: a self-describing record cannot verify itself. Adapts, at concept level only, the external m1guel1982/mova-context egress audit's per-unit decision model; no code or text was copied.
